description: On r-def-cat-txn-rel-accdb: process B opens a dynaset on ChildCD, calls Edit on the first row and sets V = 999 (not updated). Process A runs DELETE FROM Parent WHERE ID = 3 (R_CD cascades to ChildCD) without dbFailOnError, then reads Database.RecordsAffected, DBEngine.Errors and the rows of ChildCD and Parent. B then calls Update and closes; A reads the same again.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
